props.gloss_en: Beit Hillel: one reads the Shema standing, sitting, reclining, walking on the way, or working
R' Elazar ben Azarya's charge, by the parable of the beard: whatever I do, you do the opposite -- while I was upright you reclined, and now that I reclined you sat up
R' Yishmael: I acted in accordance with Beit Hillel
R' Yishmael: and you acted in accordance with Beit Shammai
R' Yishmael: and furthermore [I sat up] lest the students see and fix the halakha for generations
Beit Hillel's allowance of reclining applies to one who was reclining from the outset; one who was upright and reclines at the Shema's hour will be taken to hold as Beit Shammai
Rav Yechezkel: one who acted as Beit Shammai has acted [validly]
Rav Yechezkel: one who acted as Beit Hillel has acted [validly]
Rav Yosef: one who acted as Beit Shammai has done nothing at all
Rav Nachman bar Yitzchak: one who acted as Beit Shammai is liable to death
Beit Shammai invalidate: head and most of the body in the sukkah, table inside the house
Beit Hillel's incident: the elders of both schools visited R' Yochanan ben HaChoranit, found him with his head and most of his body in the sukkah and his table in the house, and said nothing to him
Beit Shammai: they in fact told him -- if you were accustomed to act thus, you never fulfilled the mitzva of sukkah in your life
R' Tarfon: I was coming on the way and reclined to read as Beit Shammai, and endangered myself from the bandits
the Sages: you deserved to forfeit your life, for you transgressed the words of Beit Hillel

supports.gloss_en: אמרו להם בית הלל לבית שמאי: מעשה... ולא אמרו לו כלום -- the elders of both schools found him so and said nothing

deflected_by.gloss_en: ומשם ראיה?! אף הם אמרו לו: אם כן היית נוהג לא קיימת מצות סוכה מימיך -- is that a proof? they in fact told him he had never fulfilled the mitzva of sukkah

supports.gloss_en: דתנן... אף הם אמרו לו: אם כן היית נוהג לא קיימת מצות סוכה מימיך -- the mishnah has Beit Shammai deny fulfilment outright to one who acted otherwise than they rule
דתנן, אמר רבי טרפון... אמרו לו: כדאי היית לחוב בעצמך שעברת על דברי בית הלל -- our mishnah has the Sages tell R' Tarfon he deserved to forfeit his life for acting as Beit Shammai
